reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, and anyone can print that; I look for NSF or USP, and there are no reviews at all. I don't put something in my body that my doctor suggested on the word of a brand with zero reviews, when there are magnesium brands with thousands of reviews I can check for stomach issues.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP mark. A QR code to a report the brand itself links to is not the same as third-party certification, and I can't check complaints about stomach upset, pill size or whether the dose on the box is real.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification mark on the listing, plus a few hundred verified reviews where the 1-star complaints about stomach and dosing look clean.
